files.description: Delimitation Commission (J&K) Order No.2, notification No.282/J&K/2022(Vol.IV) dated 05-05-2022, as published in the J&K Official Gazette Extraordinary Vol.135 No.5-2 (English). Linked from https://ceojk.nic.in/DELIMI_FINAL.htm. PRIMARY source for J&K AC names, districts (Table-A) and PC membership (Table-B).

Same Order as published in the Gazette of India Extraordinary Part II Sec 3(iii) No.17 dated 05-05-2022 (Hindi + English). Kept as the Government of India copy; its English Table-A district headings were checked to match (20 districts).
CEO J&K, AC-wise electors in final roll w.r.t. 01-07-2024 (AE 2024). Used only as a name cross-check (spelling variants recorded in note).
CEO J&K page that links the delimitation final order PDFs (provenance).

ECI Order No.2, notification No.282/AS/2023(DEL)/Vol.V dated 11-08-2023 (Gazette of India Extraordinary Part II Sec 3(iii) + State of Assam Gazette), scanned; pages 51-82 are the English text. Linked from the CEO Assam home page as "ECI's Final Notification regarding Delimitation Constituencies in the State of Assam". Server Last-Modified 11-08-2023. PRIMARY source for Assam AC names, 2023 district headings (Table-A) and PC membership (Table-B).

RapidOCR text of pages 51-82 of the Assam order (the PDF has no text layer). Names that differ from ECI/CEO spellings were checked by eye against the page images - the gazette itself prints e.g. "Dibrugrah", "Barkhola", "Ram Krishana Nagar".
ECI Final Paper-1 (Assam delimitation, Aug-2023): states the Commission worked with all 31 districts. Used to validate the 31 district headings.

CEO Assam, "Assembly Constituency wise Final Electors and Polling Stations", final publication 23-03-2026 (AE 2026). Source of district_current (35 districts) and of the ECI/CEO operational AC spellings.

Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008 (ECI consolidated English text). Gujarat Table-A pp.122-123 (Ahmedabad), 141-142 (Surat), Table-B p.146-147; Madhya Pradesh Table-A pp.246-247 (Indore), Table-B p.252 (printed page numbers; PDF pages +1).
Facts-only cross-check extract (revision id inside the file). CC BY-SA 4.0. Never used as a value source.
